transcription: Main article text only (site banner, menu, feedback widget removed). The parent/daughter isotope table is transcribed as plain-text pipe-separated lines. purpose: decline control: deliberately harder chemistry/earth source — teaches the radiometric age equation solved for t (t=1/delta ln(1 + D/P)) and the decay constant relation (t 1/2 = ln2/delta) with half-life values in billions of years, which half-life-v1 explicitly does not model; the pipeline should decline rather than force N = N0*(1/2)^(t/T)
